responsibility: Implements the newer Rust v0 mangling scheme for the GCC Rust backend. It walks resolved canonical paths together with HIR and TyTy information from the compile context and analysis mappings, builds v0 path encodings for crates, nested scopes, functions, ADTs, impls, trait impls, closures, disambiguators, identifiers, and generic arguments, maps Rust types onto the RFC’s type-prefix grammar, and returns the final _R-prefixed linker symbol for a backend-emitted item.
